bigIdea: Families who plan with Larder throw away a third less food, and they keep paying because the savings show on every receipt.

beats.name: Problem
beats.claim: A family of four throws away $1,500 of food a year.

beats.name: Impact
beats.claim: Most of it was bought without a plan and never cooked.

beats.name: Existing Approaches
beats.claim: Recipe apps plan meals but never look at what is already in the fridge.

beats.name: Solution
beats.claim: Larder plans the week from what you already have.

beats.name: Proof
beats.claim: Families on Larder waste a third less food, and 71% still use it after six months.

beats.name: Call to Action
beats.claim: We are raising $1.5M to reach 50,000 families.
